name: ankyrin repeat domain 11

function.text: ANKRD11 encodes ankyrin repeat domain-containing protein 11. It participates in face morphogenesis and skeletal system morphogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to KBG syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Malignant Lymphoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
